title: Fundamentals of Physics — Halliday, Resnick & Walker (11th Ed)
description: Halliday, Resnick and Walker Fundamentals of Physics 11th Edition. Good condition — some highlighting in chapters 1-5 only, no torn pages, spine intact. All problems complete. Ideal for JEE, NEET and university physics. Bought for ₹950 at college bookstore. Perfect for a first-year engineering student.

title: Introduction to Algorithms — CLRS, 3rd Edition
description: A comprehensive computer science textbook by Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson, Ronald L. Rivest and Clifford Stein, published by MIT Press. Covers algorithm design and analysis, sorting, searching, data structures, graph algorithms, dynamic programming and computational complexity. An excellent academic reference for undergraduate computer science students and programming enthusiasts. Pre-owned copy in good condition, with minor signs of use.

title: Data Structures and Algorithms — Cormen (CLRS) 3rd Edition
description: Introduction to Algorithms (CLRS) 3rd Edition by Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest, and Stein. Essential for CS engineering, competitive programming and placements. Light pencil annotations in first three chapters, all erasable. Binding strong, all 1312 pages present. This book is commonly called the 'bible of algorithms'. Bought for ₹1,450, selling to clear shelf space after graduation.

title: Manto Ki Kahaniyaan — Complete Stories of Saadat Hasan Manto
description: Complete collected short stories of Saadat Hasan Manto in Urdu script, Rajkamal Prakashan edition. One of the most important Urdu literary collections ever published. Includes Toba Tek Singh, Khol Do, Bu and all major works. Hardcover, well preserved, minor yellowing at page edges typical of its age. Owned by a literature professor, gifted to him by a student in 1991.

title: Organic Chemistry — Morrison & Boyd (6th Ed) for JEE
description: Morrison & Boyd Organic Chemistry 6th Edition — the gold standard reference for JEE Advanced organic chemistry. Lightly used, no missing pages, excellent binding. Some chapter headings highlighted. This is the original Prentice Hall edition, not a photocopy. Perfect for JEE aspirants or B.Sc chemistry students. Free shipping to anywhere in India.

title: The God of Small Things — First Edition Paperback, Arundhati Roy
description: First Indian paperback edition of The God of Small Things by Arundhati Roy, IndiaInk / HarperCollins 1997. This was Roy's debut novel that won the Booker Prize. Lightly yellowed at edges as expected for its age. All text completely clear, no annotations. A piece of Indian literary history. Spine mildly worn, cover shows shelf use. For the serious reader or collector.

title: Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal (43rd Edition)
description: Comprehensive engineering math textbook for all university curricula and GATE. Covers linear algebra, calculus, differential equations, Fourier series, and probability. Clean margins with minimal pencil marks.

title: Engineering Mechanics: Statics and Dynamics — R.C. Hibbeler
description: Standard foundation textbook for mechanical, civil, and aerospace branches. Excellent diagrams and step-by-step problem sets. Minor cover shelf wear, intact binding.

title: A Course in Electrical and Electronic Measurements — A.K. Sawhney
description: Authoritative Indian textbook on measurement instrumentation, bridges, transducers, and signal conditioning. Essential for EE and ECE students. All pages intact.

title: Data Structures and Algorithms in Python — Goodrich, Tamassia & Goldwasser
description: Rigorous computer science textbook presenting DSA using clean object-oriented Python. Covers Big-O analysis, trees, hash tables, graphs, and dynamic programming.

title: Data Structures and Algorithm Analysis in C++ — Mark Allen Weiss (4th Ed)
description: Classic DSA in C++ textbook covering templates, sorting, graph algorithms, and disjoint sets. Excellent for coding interview preparation and semester exams.

title: The C Programming Language — Brian Kernighan & Dennis Ritchie (2nd Ed)
description: The definitive K&R C manual by the language creators. Compact, lucid explanations of pointers, memory models, structures, and UNIX system calls. Collector condition.

title: Operating System Concepts — Silberschatz, Galvin & Gagne (9th Ed)
description: The renowned 'Dinosaur' operating systems book. In-depth treatment of process scheduling, virtual memory, concurrency, deadlock, and Linux/Windows internals.

title: Database System Concepts — Korth, Silberschatz & Sudarshan (6th Ed)
description: Standard university textbook on relational database design, SQL queries, relational algebra, indexing (B+ trees), ACID transactions, and normalization.

title: Computer Networking: A Top-Down Approach — Kurose & Ross (7th Ed)
description: World-famous textbook taking readers from Application layer down to Physical layer. Covers HTTP, DNS, TCP congestion control, IP routing, and network security.

title: Core Java Volume I: Fundamentals — Cay S. Horstmann (11th Ed)
description: The authoritative, robust guide for serious programmers to Java 11+. Deep dive into streams, lambda expressions, generics, concurrency, and OOP principles.

title: Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship — Robert C. Martin
description: The seminal handbook on agile software craftsmanship by Uncle Bob Martin. Covers meaningful names, small functions, error handling, unit testing, and refactoring with real Java and C++ case studies. Clean copy, crisp spine, unmarked pages.

title: Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software — Gang of Four
description: The classic Gang of Four (GoF) reference cataloguing 23 fundamental design patterns in object-oriented software design. Includes creational, structural, and behavioral patterns with UML diagrams and implementation idioms. Light shelf wear on cover.

title: Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs (SICP) — Abelson & Sussman
description: Legendary MIT textbook on computer science fundamentals using Scheme / Lisp. Explores computational processes, data abstraction, modularity, interpreters, and compilation. Second edition paperback, clean margins, tightly bound.

title: A Brief History of Time — Stephen Hawking
description: Stephen Hawking's landmark exploration of theoretical cosmology, the Big Bang, black holes, light cones, and the arrow of time for general readers. Bantam illustrated paperback edition with pristine cover and unmarked text.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind — Yuval Noah Harari
description: Yuval Noah Harari's groundbreaking chronicle of human evolution, from early hominids through the Cognitive, Agricultural, and Scientific Revolutions. Harper paperback with clean pages, uncreased spine, crisp corner folds.

title: 1984 — George Orwell (Signet Classic Paperback)
description: George Orwell's definitive dystopian masterpiece warning against authoritarian surveillance, doublethink, and Newspeak in the totalitarian state of Oceania. Signet mass-market edition, vintage cover art, solid binding.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird — Harper Lee (Harper Perennial Modern Classics)
description: Pulitzer Prize-winning novel following Scout Finch and Atticus Finch in Maycomb, Alabama, confronting racial injustice and the destruction of innocence in the American South. Harper Perennial edition with afterword.

title: The Great Gatsby — F. Scott Fitzgerald (Scribner Edition)
description: F. Scott Fitzgerald's poignant critique of the Jazz Age and the illusion of the American Dream in 1920s Long Island. Features Francis Cugat's iconic 'Celestial Eyes' dust jacket cover artwork. Excellent readable condition.

title: Meditations — Marcus Aurelius (Modern Library Translation by Gregory Hays)
description: The private spiritual reflections and Stoic exercises of Roman Emperor Marcus Aurelius in Gregory Hays' celebrated modern English translation. Clean trade paperback, crisp margins, pristine spine.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow — Daniel Kahneman
description: Nobel laureate Daniel Kahneman's definitive tour of behavioral economics, cognitive biases, System 1 intuitive thinking versus System 2 deliberate calculation, and heuristics in decision-making. FSG trade paperback.

title: Midnight's Children — Salman Rushdie (25th Anniversary Edition)
description: Winner of the Booker Prize and the Booker of Bookers. The magical-realist epic of Saleem Sinai, born at the stroke of midnight on August 15, 1947, inextricably bound to the destiny of modern India. Unmarked interior.

title: Atomic Habits: An Easy & Proven Way to Build Good Habits — James Clear
description: Practical framework for continuous self-improvement using the four laws of behavior change: cue, craving, response, and reward. Avery hardcover/paperback with clean pages, no highlighting or margin notes.

title: Cosmos — Carl Sagan (Ballantine Books Edition)
description: Carl Sagan's lyrical journey through 15 billion years of cosmic evolution, science history, and human curiosity. Illustrated mass-market edition with color photo insert and original diagrams. Well-preserved vintage copy.

title: Gödel, Escher, Bach: An Eternal Golden Braid — Douglas Hofstadter
description: Pulitzer Prize-winning masterpiece interweaving the mathematical logic of Kurt Gödel, the visual recursion of M.C. Escher, and the polyphony of J.S. Bach to explore human consciousness and artificial intelligence.
